data.one_liner: Animated backgrounds for Flutter with customizable particle behaviors.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedBackground widget that renders various animated patterns like particles, bubbles, and racing lines on a canvas. It can also be easily extended to paint custom visuals.
use_when: You want to add animated particle or background effects behind your Flutter widgets.
You need an easily extensible canvas painting solution for backgrounds.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions.
You are building performance-critical apps where custom canvas animations might cause frame drops on lower-end devices.
strengths: Includes several built-in behaviors like random particles, bubbles, and space warp.
Easily extensible to paint custom graphics on the canvas.
weaknesses: May impact performance on lower-end devices if too many particles are rendered.
Limited documentation outside of the README and basic examples.
data.setup_notes: Requires the TickerProviderStateMixin in a Stateful Widget or a provided ticker provider.
